sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE CXV OF 1996
ORDINANCE CXV OF 1996
PRESIDENT'S SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND
PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
President's Salary, Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 12th December, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 12‑12‑1996.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the President's Salary Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975 (LVIII of
1975) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances, exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the President's Salary, Allowances and Privileges (Amendment)
Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
